primary_metric.name: normalized_family_discovery_recall_auc
primary_metric.definition: Trapezoidal area under cumulative family-FDR recall versus executed fraction, including the fixed origin (0,0) and all prespecified budgets.

feedback.inconclusive: candidate is estimable but not a family-FDR chain hit
feedback.contradicted: not used because direction was not preregistered

comparison.test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip test on the primary metric
comparison.multiplicity: Holm correction across the six baseline comparisons
comparison.confidence_interval: 95% percentile bootstrap interval for paired mean difference

clear_sota_rule: NeuroDiscovery must have the highest mean primary metric and, versus every baseline, a positive mean difference, a positive 95% bootstrap lower bound, and Holm-adjusted one-sided P < 0.05.
